rendered: The TGA-DTG data in Fig. 4[1] show components burned off the recovered NMC622: an organic coating layer and carbon black (CB). The organic coating layer accounts for a ~3.3 wt% loss at ~350 °C[2], and the CB for a ~4.1 wt% loss at ~550 °C[3]. Calcination in air at 600 °C[4] removes both of them, as the text says they "can be both removed by calcining in air" at that temperature. The temperatures in the text are approximate; the DTG minima in the plot sit somewhat lower.
